name: SPARK by SILEX
description:
SPARK by SILEX is a structured products platform serving finance professionals. 

With the SPARK connector, query your portfolio in natural language directly from Claude: search products, access detailed term sheets, track lifecycle events such as autocall observations, coupon payments and redemptions, and monitor upcoming maturities. 

Stay on top of your structured products without leaving your conversation. Available to SPARK clients with an active account; authentication uses your existing SPARK credentials.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SPARK by SILEX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SPARK by SILEX to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://spark-mcp.silex-partners.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SPARK by SILEX MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SPARK by SILEX provides these MCP tools: actively_managed_product_details, actively_managed_products, list_structured_products, structured_product_details, structured_product_events, and structured_products_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SPARK by SILEX?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SPARK by SILEX in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does SPARK by SILEX MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: SPARK by SILEX requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SPARK by SILEX is developed by SILEX TECHNOLOGIES. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
